name: Why is a final quality walkthrough important for my construction project?

mainEntity.name: Why is a final quality walkthrough important for my construction project?

acceptedAnswer.text: A final quality walkthrough is important because it provides you with a formal opportunity to review the completed work and ensure it meets your expectations and the agreed-upon project scope before final acceptance. It allows for the identification and correction of any issues before they become larger problems, safeguarding your investment and ensuring your long-term satisfaction with the finished construction.
acceptedAnswer.description: It's important for you to formally review the work, ensure it meets expectations, and address any issues before final acceptance.
